comparison_policy: C0 exact historical B1 endpoint prompt and parser. C1 removes coded block state and first_activity_day; preserves observations, all raw-displacement semantics, final activity/uncertain intervals and coordinate checks. Frozen five wording anchors only
validation_policy: Final intervals use the same strict inclusive integer, target, disjointness and missing-mask checks. Simplified contract requires exact block endpoints and bounded text but cannot machine-check free-text consistency. No old-schema fallback, clipping, repair or retry
candidate_policy: All 17 original targets, same two raw PNGs, original phase0 list, no tick/scale/context/value/derivative/label changes
schedule: Two complete passes; sort case/target and alternate arm order by target ordinal plus repetition; no selective reruns
stage_policy: Same saved XGBoost head, features, support and missing mask; no training or threshold change
development_check: Each repeat separately: C1 detects all 81 weak days, does not increase failed targets, FP days or false-acceleration days, and does not reduce daily activity F1 or stage macro-F1 relative to concurrent C0. Both repeats must pass. Exploratory, not independent superiority
report_policy: All calls, all targets and complete six records scored including stationary no-candidate case. Separate contract failure burden from interval accuracy; preserve original text for semantic review, no repaired scores or success-only official results
limits: Six previously viewed synthetic development records, correlated AI-assisted labels previously exposed to generator truth, one 81-day weak episode, two repeats. Parser rejection burden differs by design; fewer failures alone is not better perception. Offline centered stage features include future information; no independent, field or online superiority claim
